title: A Cipher for the Contact
author: Elodie Vasquez
blurb: Noor Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
